title: Tam Com Nourishing Bowl
description: A wholesome bowl filled with nourishing ingredients and the crunch of wild mushrooms.

ingredients.name: Wild Mushrooms
ingredients.notes: such as shiitake or oyster mushrooms

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of sesame oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced wild mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the vegetable broth, coconut milk, and soy sauce to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 5-7 minutes or until the liquid has reduced slightly.
Stir in the tapioca starch to thicken the mixture.
To serve, divide the cooked com among bowls and top with the mushroom and broth mixture.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and thinly sliced green onions.
